title: Every shift always has a start time - none is created without one
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on a desktop browser with Schedule: Edit.
2. Work order lines are available to schedule.
3. You are on the Schedule page.
custom_steps:
1. Create shifts by each entry point available: week-view drop on a technician, day-view drop on the timeline, drop on the Unassigned row.
2. Open each created shift's detail and read its start time.
custom_expected:
1. Every created shift has a concrete start time - resolved from the hierarchy (technician hours, then business hours, then 7:00 AM default) or from the day-view drop position.
2. No shift appears on the grid without a time.
